build_leditspp_pipeline: build a LEDits++ pipeline for Stable Diffusion XL to perform textual image editing
create_function_invert: create an image inversion function that reverses diffusion to extract latents from a source image
run_pipeline_edit: run the LEDits++ pipeline to edit an inverted image using editing prompts and guidance parameters
create_attention_store: create an attention store to capture and aggregate cross-attention and self-attention maps during diffusion
compute_noise_inversion: compute noise residuals during image inversion using DDIM or SDE-DPM++ schedulers
